starters.name: template_3d_empty
starters.description: A blank 3D root. Add a camera and mark it current before you build on this. Next: `scenes/stage.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_empty
starters.description: A blank 2D root. Add a camera and make it current before you build on this. Next: `scenes/sheet.tscn`.

starters.name: template_android
starters.description: A blank phone root. A panel under the status bar is rejected. Next: `scenes/panel.tscn`.

starters.name: template_ios
starters.description: A blank phone root. A panel under the notch is rejected. Next: `scenes/panel.tscn`.

starters.name: template_web
starters.description: A blank page root. Input before the page has focus is rejected. Next: `scenes/page.tscn`.

starters.name: template_platform_menu
starters.description: One sheet that runs the Android, iOS, and Web rules. An unknown example is rejected. Next: `scenes/board.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_basic
starters.description: One camera, one light, and one floor. Next: `scenes/annex.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_fps_movement
starters.description: First-person walk, mouse look, and jump inside a box arena. Shift sprints. Next: `scenes/ramp.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_city
starters.description: A short block street and a walker. Block widths come from a seed. Next: `scenes/cross.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_controller
starters.description: Orbit a walker and take one shot at a crate. A second shot before the yard refill is rejected. Next: `scenes/yard.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_platformer
starters.description: Run and jump one level. The goal does not count while the runner still overlaps the hazard. Next: `scenes/span.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_platformer
starters.description: Jump onto one platform and reach the goal. A second jump in the air is rejected. Next: `scenes/rise.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_dungeon
starters.description: Sixteen seeded carvers, from rooms and caves through Prim's and the other mazes. The exit also needs a token. Next: `scenes/inner.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_dungeon
starters.description: The same sixteen carvers drawn as boxes. The exit also needs a token. Next: `scenes/deeper.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_push_puzzle
starters.description: Slide one crate onto one plate. A push into a wall or a blocker is rejected. Next: `scenes/board_two.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_fps_combat
starters.description: Look and shoot one target. Primary fires. Leap reloads only at zero rounds. Next: `scenes/second_mark.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_lan
starters.description: Local ENet host and join, one spawn marker, and one hit. A port outside 1 to 65535 is rejected. Next: `scenes/pit.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_tower_defense
starters.description: One lane, one defender, one spend. Primary places. Leap marches. A place you cannot afford is rejected. Next: `scenes/bend.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_survivor
starters.description: Move inside a spawn region. Primary admits one foe, grants XP, and upgrades at the threshold. Next: `scenes/pick.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_vehicle
starters.description: Walk a short seeded road and enter one car. A second enter while seated is rejected. Next: `scenes/stretch.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_metroidvania
starters.description: Two rooms and a gate. Primary takes the dash. Leap crosses only after the dash is owned. Next: `scenes/room_b.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_exploration
starters.description: Orbit, walk, and pick up one token into a four-slot pack. Drop the oldest item to store a fifth. A blank id is rejected. Next: `scenes/grove.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_card_battle
starters.description: Elixir regenerates. Primary deploys on your half and strikes the tower. Leap plays the costly card. Next: `scenes/result.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_racing
starters.description: Drive one oval. Hold stride north. A lap counts only after the mid stripe, then the start stripe. Next: `scenes/finish.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_turn_battle
starters.description: Three steps north enter a fight. Primary strikes. Leap guards. An action on the other side is skipped. Next: `scenes/fight.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_coop
starters.description: Two local bodies with different health pools. Primary applies a host hit. Leap tries a client hit and is rejected. Next: `scenes/roster.tscn`.

starters.name: template_2d_menus
starters.description: Main, pause, settings, credits, save, and load as separate Control scenes you can copy. Three slots reject a bad index, a bad version, and an overwrite without confirm. Next: `scenes/play_stage.tscn`.

starters.name: template_3d_menus
starters.description: The same menus as lit 3D panels with a current camera. Copy one board scene and its script. Slots and prefs match the 2D starter. Next: `scenes/play_yard.tscn`.
